brief:
Delays and long lines have disrupted voting at polling stations in Palestinian communities within Israel, according to a monitor tracking the election process, Middle East Eye reported. The exact cause of the delays was not specified in the initial reporting.

Palestinian citizens of Israel make up roughly one-fifth of the country's population. The disruptions come as voting occurs across Israeli communities.
dek: Monitor warns of delays at polling stations in Palestinian communities in Israel Delays and long lines have been reported at polling stations in Palestinian communities in Israel, according to a monitor.
title: Polling delays hit Palestinian communities in Israel
